How about we specify `string | ForceData | undefined`

To be honest, I don't like the `|` union.  How about we remove usage of strings in there, and just use:
```
  selectedForce?: ForceData
```

Aah, but we **certainly don't** want to store the whole `ForceData` object when we persist to database.
Hmm, I think the above needs to be `&&`. Both need to be false to be sure it's not the system doc
Yes, this part is for updating "initial_wargame" and I added "settings" if "initial_wargame" doesn't exist.

issues.title: Refactor how we save channel & force
issues.body:
Our save-channel/save-force logic is complex because it uses `name` to index the channels/forces, but the `name` could change.

Since that was written, we now index channels. & forces by `uniqid` - so the `saveChannel`\`saveForce` code in `wargames_api` can be simplified.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/165298879-9b85dc46-cb8e-4d3b-a7e3-dde6a92b3852.png)
